scope_boundary: This guide pack covers the 13 canonical programs in buddy-benchmark-index.json. The repository contains additional benchmark configs, suites, and scripts not yet exhaustively reconciled to this index; this is not a claim that every benchmark reference in the repository has an individual guide.
truth_boundary: All guides are original specifications. No benchmark was executed, no score was measured, no threshold was invented, and no capability was certified.

programs.title: Repository contracts and interfaces

programs.benchmark_purpose: Evaluate repository contracts and interfaces using reproducible, bounded evidence within the scope: Source files, API routes, pages, test files, dependencies, and governed suites.
methodology: Define the target capability, user outcome, prohibited actions, and exact acceptance contract.
Pin the source commit, generator version, dependencies, model/provider versions, and environment where applicable.
Build deterministic fixtures and a baseline before comparing a candidate.
Separate training/development examples from private holdout fixtures and record hashes.
Run the canonical check command only in an authorized, isolated environment; preserve stdout, stderr, exit code, and artifacts.
Score only declared metrics; keep thresholds source-defined or explicitly pending rather than inventing values.
Analyze failures, regressions, uncertainty, cost, latency, and user effort.
Require independent review before changing certification, routing, or production eligibility.

thresholds.rule: Do not invent numerical thresholds; link each threshold to the canonical benchmark contract or leave pending.

programs.baseline_and_comparator: Use the current main-branch implementation and a deterministic baseline; competitor comparisons require the same fixtures, versions, permissions, and resource budgets.
